context for my dumb idea: in Super Robot Wars, each major character has their theme, and there's a priority list that determines whose plays in a battle between two (so your units will override nameless mooks, bosses override yours). there's one character who's originally an enemy and joins your side, but the boss flag for the theme never gets unset, so his theme, *Trombe!*, overrides literally every other one, including the final boss.

it became a community meme which the creators acknowledged, keeping it in all next games as a feature that *Trombe!* overrides any other theme, and eventually there were two bosses in later games that deliberately overrode it - one of them was, one boss had a giant airship, with a stereo setup on board, and blasted *The Blue Danube* across the battlefield as an in-universe excuse for that music to take priority
